acceptance: Every output passes complete untimed topology/text/geometry oracle and timed archive hash/bytes/counters. Retain all12lanes with source/build identity and every normal repeat flag above5percent. Measure actual operation peak by shape; expose increasing structural term rather than claiming constant total memory. Any nonzero live exit delta investigated.
limits: No logical append, Part addition, arbitrary edits/repackaging, native Office, broad-format feature, source-variant or worker-scaling proof. Full-process RSS includes materializing preflight; no RSS causality claim.
memory_scope: Allocator target callback-order operation requested-heap peak minus entry and live exit minus entry, including writer, text generation, active slide and growing ZIP directory/member metadata. Excludes allocator-internal realloc overlap, physical copies, RSS and retained preflight. Zero retained sink output; slide XML byte ceiling is not a retained-memory window.
scope: Descriptive fresh plain PPTX slide creation only; no before/after production or registered latency claim.
timing_scope: Finite limits construction, deterministic slide text generation, public writer new/start/write/finish, Deflate/ZIP finalization and writer destruction. Sink construction and digest extraction, process/allocator boundary reads, materialized preflight and reopen excluded.
